question: Why do outdoor-seating stores waste more on some days?

sql:
SELECT s.date, s.store_id, SUM(w.units_wasted) AS waste_units, SUM(s.units_sold) AS sales_units
FROM cases.sales_table s
JOIN cases.waste_table w ON s.date = w.date AND s.store_id = w.store_id AND s.product = w.product
WHERE s.outdoor_seating = 'True'
GROUP BY s.date, s.store_id
ORDER BY waste_units DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT w.date, w.store_id, w.product, w.units_wasted, w.waste_cost, s.outdoor_seating, s.area_type, s.promo_flag, we.precipitation_mm, h.holiday_name
FROM cases.waste_table w
JOIN cases.sales_table s ON w.date = s.date AND w.store_id = s.store_id AND w.product = s.product
LEFT JOIN cases.weather_table we ON w.date = we.date
LEFT JOIN cases.holidays_table h ON w.date = h.date
WHERE w.units_wasted > 100
ORDER BY w.units_wasted DESC
LIMIT 20;
SELECT date, store_id, product, units_wasted FROM cases.waste_table LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.date, s.store_id, s.outdoor_seating, s.area_type, s.product, s.units_sold, s.revenue, s.promo_flag,
       w.units_wasted, w.waste_cost,
       we.precipitation_mm, h.holiday_name
FROM cases.sales_table s
JOIN cases.waste_table w ON s.date = w.date AND s.store_id = w.store_id AND s.product = w.product
LEFT JOIN cases.weather_table we ON s.date = we.date
LEFT JOIN cases.holidays_table h ON s.date = h.date
WHERE s.outdoor_seating = 'True'
LIMIT 30;

SELECT w.date, s.store_id, s.outdoor_seating, AVG(w.units_wasted) AS avg_waste, AVG(s.units_sold) AS avg_sales, AVG(we.precipitation_mm) AS avg_rain, COUNT(DISTINCT s.product) AS products
FROM cases.sales_table s
JOIN cases.waste_table w ON s.date = w.date AND s.store_id = w.store_id AND s.product = w.product
LEFT JOIN cases.weather_table we ON s.date = we.date
WHERE s.outdoor_seating = 'True'
GROUP BY w.date, s.store_id
ORDER BY avg_waste DESC
LIMIT 20;
